run_boundprop_crown_ibp: run boundprop with crown_ibp method to compute interval bounds for neural network intermediate activations
run_boundprop_nonconvex: run boundprop with nonconvex method to compute tighter interval bounds using Wolfe nonconvex bound propagation
build_crown_ibp_layer_bounds: build per-layer CROWN-IBP bounds for a neural network given parameters, input, epsilon, and input bounds
build_nonconvex_layer_bounds: build per-layer nonconvex bounds for a neural network using FISTA optimizer and parallel nodes
test_boundprop_type_dispatch: test the boundprop type dispatch to select crown_ibp or nonconvex bound propagation method
